name: VWA World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The promotion's top prize, won in a tainted eight-man tournament final and still on Derek Holmes's shoulder in a sibling federation's own account nearly two years later.

name: VWA North American Championship
epitaph: Won in a thirty-two-man battle royal at the promotion's first pay-per-view and still in dispute by its second, its full lineage not recovered in this record.

name: VWA World Television Championship
epitaph: Defended on a weekly basis under the promotion's own rules; only a single defense survives in this record.

name: VWA World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Won by the Travis Brothers from Demolition in a two-out-of-three-falls match at the promotion's first pay-per-view.

name: VWA North American Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Won by the Steiner Brothers from Harlem Heat at the promotion's first pay-per-view; billed as held by Law and Order, whose own claim is not otherwise attested, by the promotion's second.
